search_window.basis: Previous verified supplementary Food Line heartbeat completion through the current watch completion; publication/event time must be established inside this window to qualify as a new signal.

coverage_notes: Supplementary bounded Food Line recall watch only; production nationwide collector remains authoritative.

12 targeted web searches completed: sole/only/full-service grocery-store loss or fire; weather/disaster/outage-related emergency food distribution cancellation; abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or loss of service; and official SNAP/WIC/EBT benefit interruption. No individual search failure reported.
Applied October 24–25, 2026 keyword searches and two-day recency settings; newness was evaluated against the previous verified heartbeat completion at 09:50:01 PDT.

Results did not establish a qualifying disruption newly published or newly announced in the one-hour observation window. Grocery-fire and sole-store-loss matches referred to earlier dates (e.g. Spencer, NY September 11–14); SNAP/WIC shutdown matches referred to 2025 or earlier 2026; pantry notices were stale, routine scheduling, or relocations rather than newly announced disruptions.
Potential historical pantry access leads in earlier heartbeats were not re-promoted as new events without a verified first publication time.
Search index freshness and social-media visibility limit completeness; no inference that no incidents happened nationwide.
Excluded donations, routine distributions, resource listings, recipes, opinion, general inflation, international cases, and duplicate/old incidents.
No approval, publication, schedule modification, production collector mutation, or task disablement performed.
